name: consolio-plugin-idempotency-key
author: Consolio
description: Adds a unique Idempotency-Key header to POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests, so retrying a failed send during manual testing can't double-charge or double-create against APIs that honor it (Stripe-style).
useCase: Safely retry payment, order, and mutation requests during failure testing when the API supports idempotency keys.
